effects.description: Cara launches a powerful cannon at enemies, dealing Attack * 280% Area damage.

Cara fires a Steamy Whammy, releasing a mist-like gas that obscures the vision of the enemy and reduces their accuracy by 15%. The gas burns the targets continuously, dealing Attack * 15% damage every 0.5 seconds for 2 seconds.
Each time an ally Hero is knocked down, the rage and power of Cara are fueled, increasing Attack by 15% until the end of the battle.
Cara drops smoke grenades from the air, hindering enemy attacks and reducing their Lethality by 20%.
The Mech Pets crafted by Oestermore crafters join forces with the warriors, increasing normal attack damage by 30% for all troops.

effects.effect-name: Extra Damage to Lancer and Marksman
effects.description: Thanks to the flying broom of Cara, she effortlessly bypasses the enemy Infantry on the frontline. The Marksman of Cara deal 40% extra damage to enemy Lancer and 20% extra damage to enemy Marksman every two attacks.

exploration.ability: The crafters from Oestermore modify the gear of Cara, increasing the duration of Gloomy Mist by {v1} and increasing normal attack damage by {v2}.
exploration.name: Techno Power

expedition.ability: Cara defends the city like a hometown, inspiring defending Troop and increasing their Lethality by {v1}.
expedition.name: Shrouded Haven
